name: Ray Tracing-Based Image Warping for Remote Volume Rendering
definition: A remote rendering technique that decouples rendering and display by sending object-space samples (position and color) from server to client. The client interprets these samples as semi-transparent spheres and renders them using first-hit ray tracing, replacing the rasterized point primitives of the base method to reduce reprojection artifacts.
summary: Ray Tracing-Based Image Warping for Remote Volume Rendering decouples rendering by sending object-space samples to a client, where first-hit ray tracing of semi-transparent spheres eliminates reprojection artifacts caused by fixed-size point primitives.
